summary: The agent failed the verifier despite claiming success, primarily due to creating circular references in the Ending Balance control row (=B10+C10-D10 on row 10) — the exact anti-pattern the existing skill warns about. The agent also wrote a one-off script instead of adapting the existing template, and skipped running the provided verify_workbook.py script. This patch strengthens the existing financial-rollforward-workbook skill by: (1) making the circular reference warning more prominent and explicit about the Ending Balance row specifically, (2) adding a mandatory verification checkpoint before claiming success, (3) adding a warranty-reserve sub-task invariant section, and (4) clarifying that the verify script must be run from the skill directory.
